title: Parking API in Express
idea: The parking API exposes entries, tickets and payments as REST resources, with each layer doing one job: controller validates, service decides inside a transaction, repository runs SQL.

analogy.text: A toll booth. The booth clerk checks your pass is readable, the supervisor decides the charge, and the cash drawer only stores money.
analogy.breaks: A supervisor can bend rules; the service never does.

points: Entering is `POST /entries`; it returns 201 with a ticket, or 409.
Paying is `POST /tickets/:id/payments` with an Idempotency-Key; replays return 200.
`zod` rejects bad bodies and missing keys with 400 before the service runs.
One error middleware maps domain errors and constraint names to status codes.

code.title: Layered Express app
code.caption: Repository, service, controllers and error mapping in one file, on a real PostgreSQL. Charging the card is left out; the Payment System chapter covers it.

walk.text: Trimmed schema: spots, tickets with one open visit per plate, payments with a unique key.
A fixed demo clock, fit and rate tables, and `tx` for one transaction per call.
One UPDATE locks and occupies the first free fitting spot, skipping rows other gates hold.
Service `enter`: 409 LOT_FULL when no row comes back, else insert the ticket.
Service `pay`: replay a known key (real code checks its ticket), else pay an ACTIVE ticket.
Controllers parse with `zod`; Express 5 forwards async throws to the error middleware.
Map validation, domain errors and the plate index to codes; a racing duplicate key becomes 409.

pitfalls: Do not return 500 when the lot is full; 409 tells the gate to show FULL.
Check the Idempotency-Key before the state check, or a retry looks like an error.
Never charge a card inside an open transaction; row locks stay held while waiting.

quiz.q: What does the second POST /entries print?
quiz.why: The plate is normalised to the same value. The ticket insert breaks `one_visit_per_plate`, the transaction rolls back, and the middleware maps that constraint to 409.

takeaway: Validate in the controller, decide in one transaction, replay safely by key.

starters: Why does the truck get ticket 3 instead of ticket 2?
